description: Turn text into embedding vectors (OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings) for semantic search, clustering or deduplication. Returns one vector per input. text-embedding-3-small: $0.018 per 1M tokens, 1536 dimensions; text-embedding-3-large: $0.059 per 1M tokens, 3072 dimensions.

dimensions.description: Optional: shorten the vectors to this many dimensions.

input.description: One string, or a list of up to 256 strings.

name: embed
